verdict.rationale: Undermind's own background automation is topic monitoring: it notifies users when relevant papers are published (docs-9), and enterprise 'role-aware alerts' monitor saved topics and send tailored updates (docs-46). Its deep-research agent also plans and runs searches autonomously until it stops finding relevant papers (docs-4, docs-16), but that is an on-demand task rather than a configured background automation. missing for 10: user-configurable automations beyond topic alerts (schedules, triggers, chained actions), documentation of how alerts are set up and controlled, recurring autonomous research runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the alerting feature.
